notes: The exact R02 slice submission is approved. The evidence, product candidate, all-task-approved state, prior adverse ledger, and submission ancestry are authentic and append-only. Independent replay closes CAP-03.S03-INTEGRATION-R01-F01 across every boundary named by R01. SQLite now reports cursor-limit or scan-limit instead of silently treating an incomplete graph as terminal verified authority; Core/Pydantic, OpenAPI, the generated client, renderer merge/readiness logic, and the visible workspace state preserve integrity-review and export denial. Source inspection confirms LineageNode materialization is bounded to pageSize while breadth-first SQLite traversal is processed in 256-revision batches. The independent real 4,161-revision/16,642-fact Windows rerun reproduced both limit denials, stable reopened ordering, and a 7.164-second p95 under the recorded 18-second regression limit. All 15 prior task findings remain closed, and no new blocking or nonblocking acceptance-bound defect was identified. Extremely large accepted-bound traces remain intentionally incomplete and non-exportable at the declared limit rather than falsely complete; broader cross-capability and end-to-end performance qualification remains a W1-exit obligation.

closures.details: Both silent-completeness paths are closed. A true continuation whose offset would exceed the cursor ceiling is explicitly cursor-limit, integrity-review, and non-exportable; a nonempty frontier at the scan budget is explicitly scan-limit with the same denial. Those facts are required by the Core response model, exact OpenAPI/generated decoder/client, renderer merge/readiness predicate, and visible incomplete state. The independent >10,100-fact real SQLite replay proves hidden facts cannot produce a terminal verified/exportable response, and the scan-budget replay proves an unvisited frontier cannot do so. LineageNode materialization is bounded to the requested page, and representative Windows performance evidence records the required fixture, hardware/OS/runtime, raw samples, distribution, thresholds, and stable reopened ordering.

The final task ledgers remain immutable and approved. Independent contract/schema, repository/service, generated-client/renderer, exact-hash, and source-boundary replay confirms every prior lifecycle, identity, migration, transaction, retry/restart, checkpoint/outbox, real-lineage, rights, pagination, query-binding, missing/legacy, completeness, and governed-workspace closure remains valid.

residuals.details: The current response contract intentionally stops complete local-manifest export when accepted-bound lineage exceeds the cursor or scan ceiling. Researchers retain read-only access to the returned prefix plus the explicit limit reason; no complete claim is made. A future opaque-continuation or durable-snapshot enhancement may extend inspection beyond the ceiling, but it is not required to close the false-completeness defect and must not weaken the present denial.

The independent large-graph p95 is 7.164 seconds under the recorded 18-second regression limit and 30-second absolute limit. Each page still performs full project-ledger integrity verification and accepted-bound traversal so rights/integrity/truncation authority is complete; cumulative multi-page interaction performance and any future indexed snapshot/cache optimization remain part of the complete W1 performance qualification rather than being represented as discharged here.

The complete cross-capability W1 happy, failure, denial, cancellation, migration, restart, recovery, security, accessibility, performance, packaging, and Windows x64 qualification matrix remains due at Wave exit. The two stale schema-v6 assertions and historical foundation-controller/recovery baseline remain separately disclosed reconciliation debt.
